cur:catacombs2-marseille-saint-victor-co.summary: Under seven arches, Christ stands at the centre on a mountain from which four rivers flow, crowned by the hand of God, between Peter carrying a cross and Paul; five apostles stand on each side. On the lid two deer drink between trees, an image of Paradise, while two angels hold a panel beneath a Christogram between dolphins; at the right appear the miracle at Cana and the spies carrying the grape cluster from the Promised Land.
facts: The four rivers of Paradise flowing from Christ's mountain recall the rivers of Eden in Genesis 2:10–14, a common Early Christian image of salvation.
The pairing of Cana with the grape cluster of the Promised Land on the lid juxtaposes a New Testament miracle with its Old Testament foreshadowing.
